messages:
Asha (CSM): Heads up—Acme renewal is in flight. Procurement says they can pay by CC for up to $50k, but their finance team insists the invoice must be billed to 'Acme EU Ops Ltd' with VAT details. They asked if we can do CC for the deposit and invoice for the remainder. thoughts?
Liam (AM): Thanks. They're at the last stage but Legal flagged the signature authority is different for the EU entity. Marcus sent over a note: 'We prefer CC for speed but need the invoice on Acme EU Ops Ltd and a PO for the balance.'
Priya (Finance): We can accept split payment (CC + invoice) but need a clear billing entity and tax ID. Also need purchase order reference on the invoice to avoid reconciliation issues. Who can confirm the exact VAT number?
Marcus (Procurement, Acme): FYI — VAT: GB999888777. PO team will append PO-ACME-2026-334. CC will be processed by procurement card.
Jordan (Legal): Quick flag — if the invoice is to Acme EU Ops Ltd (a different legal entity), we need an authorized signer on the SOW or a delegated signatory confirmation. Do we have a delegated signature letter?
Asha (CSM): Not yet. I asked the customer to provide delegation doc. They said they'd share it with Legal but timeline unclear. If they can't produce it, they'd like the C-level to sign instead.
Sam (Sales Ops): Operationally we can split the invoice. Two practical items: (1) invoice entity on PDF must match entity name + VAT exactly, (2) accounting needs the PO number in the invoice metadata. I'll draft a template note to attach to the invoice.
docusign-bot: Envelope 0x9f2a sent to Marcus (Procurement, Acme) for signature (SOW v3). Status: sent.
Marcus (Procurement, Acme): Signed the CC authorization section just now. Still waiting on finance to confirm the VAT entity for the invoice.
Priya (Finance): Once delegation is confirmed, I'll generate a split-invoice: line 1 (one-time deposit) charged to card, line 2 (remaining balance) invoiced to Acme EU Ops Ltd with PO-ACME-2026-334. Can we include this note on the invoice: 'Deposit paid by card on MM/DD/YYYY — see reference x123'?
Liam (AM): Yes please include that reference. Also we need to ensure the model usage billing is associated to the correct account (they have multiple orgs). Asha can you confirm which org the committed seats map to?
Asha (CSM): Confirmed — committed seats belong to org: acme-production (customer id: acme-prod-42). I'll paste that into the invoice metadata.
Jordan (Legal): One more: if the signer on the SOW is from a different entity than the invoiced party we should add an entity acknowledgement clause. I'll drop a short paragraph for approval.
Sam (Sales Ops): Drafted invoice note and routing instructions:
```
Bill to: Acme EU Ops Ltd
VAT: GB999888777
PO: PO-ACME-2026-334
Invoice split: Deposit (Card ref x123) / Balance (Invoice)
Account: acme-production (acme-prod-42)
```
Please review.
Priya (Finance): That works. I'll queue the invoice once we have the signed SOW or delegated signer doc attached. Expected batch run tomorrow morning.
Asha (CSM): I'll follow up with the customer for the delegation doc. Marcus, can you nudge finance to send the PO?
Marcus (Procurement, Acme): On it. PO will be issued by EOD. I'll ping when it's live.
Liam (AM): Great. If PO arrives and delegation doc attached, we can proceed with split payment flow and close renewal this week. :tada:
Asha (CSM): Thanks everyone — will update thread when docs land. :thumbsup:
